protocol.rr_zero_definition: No RR ratio floor; learned EV and post-cost target reward must both remain positive. All other checks preserved.
protocol.selection: Second-half VAL only; >=5 closes and positive0/15bp net, then return%-0.5*M1markedDD%; otherwise exploratory. Stable grid order.
protocol.test_status: Previously exposed historical TEST: retrospective diagnostic, not a fresh untouched holdout.
limitations: Daily forecast origins; live intraday frequency not validated.
Slippage0/5/15bp per side is an assumption; historical spread unknown.
Historical full news/LLM decisions were not backtested.
Candidate profitability counts do not imply independently allocatable profits.
